In order to get AI generated outline you just need to click “Get AI Outline” in the “Build your brief” section, next to Outline. Our AI will take into account all the data collected and based on that it will create a comprehensive outline with a logical structure.

In the popup, you will see the headings generated by AI. You can select all of them or choose some of them. Once you click the “Add selected” button they will be added to your Outline.

If you would like to generate some different [headings](https://seowind.io/blog-headings/) then you can click arrows to regenerate the outline again.

![seowind ai outline](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/AI-Outline-1024x552.png)

If the selected headings have their equivalent in the Competitor Outlines section, the particular headings will be marked and the source will be added automatically to your Outline.

## How is this different from other AI-generated outlines? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/generating-ai-outline/\#0-toc-title)

Unlike other [content brief generators](https://seowind.io/seo-content-brief-generator/) SEOwind is not creating outline suggestions based on AI. At least not solely. We are analyzing the headings of the top SERPs and choosing the ones that will make your outline most comprehensive and valuable to your readers. It’s not about being creative but data-oriented.

## When should you use AI Outline? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/generating-ai-outline/\#1-toc-title)

There are various reasons for choosing this approach.

- Some users choose AI-generated outlines in order to save time and speed up the research process. They don’t go into manual analysis enjoying the speed and quality.
- Others treat it as a starting point when building their outline.

Whatever your reasons are, it’s definitely worth looking into it to make creating briefs easier.
